prayerExcerpt.en-US: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying in the sanctuary of the Lord where the ark of God was.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A lâmpada de Deus ainda não se tinha apagado e Samuel estava dormindo no templo do Senhor, onde se encontrava a arca de Deus.

meta.basis: The tabernacle is 'irremovable', of 'solid and inviolable material that is not transparent', and locked, in a place 'truly noble, prominent, conspicuous, worthily decorated' (GIRM 314; can. 938). 'Near the tabernacle a special lamp, fueled by oil or wax, should shine permanently to indicate the presence of Christ and honor it' (GIRM 316; can. 940). Gilded metal is a traditional choice the norms allow; the red glass of the lamp is custom, not law. The excerpt is the lamp that burned before the ark in the sanctuary at Shiloh (1 Sam 3:3), the tabernacle's Old Testament type, from the First Reading of Wednesday of the First Week in Ordinary Time, Year II.
